text.p: Danielson Holding Corp and Progressive Corp said on Wednesday they signed a letter of intent for Progressive to buy about 11 million newly-issued shares of Danielson common stock for $6.60 per share.
This amounted to a 42 percent of the outstanding Danielson stock, the companies said.
Under the deal, Progressive would also be entitled to nominate four of Danielson's nine directors.
Danielson said it had also agreed not to hold discussions with any other parties regarding potential financial transactions until March 14, 1997.
Any transaction would be subject to Danielson shareholder and regulatory approval, the companies said.
Danielson is engaged, through its subsidiaries, in insurance services, primarily writing private and commercial substandard insurance in California and workers' compensation insurance.
Progressive is a Cleveland-based insurance holding company.
